FIELD EXPEDITION · EIDOLON
◇
The Patient Reef

A pale lattice grows through the planet’s crust. Each branch encloses a tool. None contains a weapon. Far below, something waits for permission to continue.

Quarry the lattice →

Gain 85 minerals. Exhaust the reef permanently.

1 order
Feed the root →

Spend 35 credits and 20 minerals to preserve the living structure.

Settle this world and operate an Orbital Extractor for three completed cycles without hostile warships in orbit. Then choose 120 minerals and 20 science, or grow Lattice Works for 80 credits, 40 minerals and 60 work. Restoration requires Autonomous Industry and one infrastructure slot (or explicit replacement), producing +4 minerals and +4 production. The opportunity stays with the world if another empire takes it; progress never expires.

◈ 35 credits · ◇ 20 minerals · 1 order

Each choice leaves a permanent record. Restorations use ordinary construction; cancelling keeps the plan but never reopens the salvage choice.
